---
title: "Temporal binding effects"
output: html_document
---

All 19 participants are included. Exact one-sided signed-rank tests use the specified directions. V reports the larger rank sum; both signed rank sums are saved.

## Read data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
root <- Sys.getenv("DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT", unset=getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,"dual-agency-pathways.Rproj"))) {
  parent <- dirname(root)
  if(identical(parent,root)) stop("Open the project or set DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT.")
  root <- parent
}
source(file.path(root,"analysis/common.R"),encoding="UTF-8",local=TRUE)
out <- out_dir("01_temporal_binding_effect"); fig <- out_dir("01_temporal_binding_effect", TRUE)
d <- read_csv(file.path(data_root, "01_temporal_binding_effect/perceptual_shift_action_outcome.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE) %>% arrange(subject)
vars <- c("va_ba", "ia_bi", "vs_bs", "is_bs")
```

## Run statistical tests

```{r statistical-tests, include=FALSE}
delta <- d$vs_bs - d$is_bs
normality <- map_dfr(c(vars, "outcome_voluntary_minus_involuntary"), function(v) {
  x <- if(v %in% vars) d[[v]] else delta
  z <- shapiro.test(x)
  tibble(variable=v, n=length(x), W=unname(z$statistic), p=z$p.value)
})
signed_rank <- function(x, label, alternative) {
  z <- wilcox.test(x, mu=0, alternative=alternative, exact=TRUE, correct=FALSE)
  tibble(comparison=label, n=length(x), mean=mean(x), median=median(x), sd=sd(x),
         alternative=alternative, V=max(unname(z$statistic),sum(rank(abs(x)))-unname(z$statistic)),
         W_positive=unname(z$statistic),W_negative=sum(rank(abs(x)))-unname(z$statistic),p=z$p.value)
}
against_zero <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) signed_rank(d[[v]], v,
  if(v %in% c("va_ba","ia_bi")) "greater" else "less"))
paired <- signed_rank(delta, "Outcome voluntary - involuntary", "less")
write_csv(normality, file.path(out,"normality.csv"))
write_csv(against_zero, file.path(out,"against_zero.csv"))
write_csv(paired, file.path(out,"outcome_paired.csv"))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(normality, digits=4)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(against_zero, digits=4)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(paired, digits=4)
```

## Plot and save

```{r plot-settings}
font_size <- 6
plot_width_cm <- 8.0
plot_height_cm <- 6.4
point_alpha <- .60
fill_alpha <- .60
point_size <- .65
action_colors <- c("#1E90FF","#FF7518")
outcome_colors <- c("#0BDA51","#FF69B4")
action_fills <- c("#9FD0F2","#FFC980")
outcome_fills <- c("#B4E39A","#F9D1DC")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=plot_width_cm/2.54, fig.height=plot_height_cm/2.54}
source(file.path(project_root,"analysis/01_temporal_binding_effect/behavior_plot_utils.R"),local=TRUE,encoding="UTF-8")
df_action <- to_long(d, c("va_ba","ia_bi"), c("va_ba","ia_bi"), c("Voluntary","Involuntary"))
df_outcome <- to_long(d, c("vs_bs","is_bs"), c("vs_bs","is_bs"), c("Voluntary","Involuntary"))
set.seed(20261030)
p_action <- plot_halfviolin(df_action,title="Action",y_breaks=seq(-150,150,50),
  palette=action_colors,fill_palette=action_fills,font_size=font_size,
  point_alpha=point_alpha,fill_alpha=fill_alpha,point_size=point_size)
p_outcome <- plot_halfviolin(df_outcome,title="Sound",y_breaks=seq(-400,0,50),
  palette=outcome_colors,fill_palette=outcome_fills,font_size=font_size,
  point_alpha=point_alpha,fill_alpha=fill_alpha,point_size=point_size)
combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_action,p_outcome,nrow=1)
for(ext in "pdf") ggsave(file.path(fig,paste0("temporal_binding.",ext)),combined,
  width=2*plot_width_cm,height=plot_height_cm,units="cm",device=if(ext=="pdf")cairo_pdf else"png",dpi=300,bg="white")
p_action
p_outcome
```
